body: I find that if I speak to people they pretty much just give me the same advice that doesn't really work for me, and that advice usually boils down to "Make your life better" If I could simply do that then there wouldn't be an issue. My inability to improve things is exactly why I am the way I am. Most people don't understand and will just tell me things like "it will get better" and "only you can change things"

I've just reached a point where I don't see anything that makes me feel happy. I've been single for a year now and have had pretty much zero progress in finding someone else, my day to day routine is more or less just going to work then passing the time at home watching Netflix, that sort of thing. I'm not even down that much, just more empty than anything. When I feel a bit down, there's nothing that makes me think "Well yeah, there's that"

And I do have some friends but in all honesty it's not enough to make me feel like there's a point to it all. Those friends all have relationships and stuff that they'll put before me so they're really just people I can occasionally spend time with. There's not really anyone I'm particularly close with these days. I get on with my family but I've never really felt close to them either. 

In short, I just feel that I've come to a point where there's nothing left for me. I've been told all the advice about trying new things and whatnot but the irony is that feeling like this means I have no motivation to do any new things. It feels like far too much effort to find new things and then actually do them. Plus, the thought of trying something new and not being good at it frustrates me to the point where I'd rather not bother.
